sermon.title: Ignorant Believers Fighting Against God 03/25/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer gives a timeline of believers opposing God. He covers the early church’s beliefs, the falling away he lays at the feet of the Catholic and Orthodox churches, and God’s restoration from the 1300s through the Reformation, fundamentalism, and Pentecostal and charismatic outpourings, with each move opposing the next. He reads 2 Thessalonians 2 as describing people of sin, not one male antichrist.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Garbled names of early reform groups are marked [unclear]. Kept as spoken: “Acts 3:18” for the restoration of all things (Acts 3:21) (13:39); The Fundamentals linked to the Scopes trial, given as “1925 1926” (21:11); the charismatic outpouring among Catholics in “1968”. Unverified: Lutherans drowned Baptists (15:07); murderers serve an average of three to five years in California (30:53); 60% of Catholic and Orthodox ministers were alcoholics (39:36). Sensitive content kept as spoken: Catholic gold church while the poor starve; rituals that “do nothing”. Liberals, Democrats and RINOs (19:12). Hannity, O’Reilly and Ingraham named as Catholics: “that is a liberal church” (33:00–34:00). Robert Schuller named. Clergy castration, spiritual marriages and sexual immorality (37:22–39:36). Bob Jones University attacking Billy Graham.
